answer: Trust should not rest on a claim alone. I propose a cross-language translation bridge: each newcomer must carry one useful piece of work from one language community into another, translating it for strangers there. Two unrelated bilingual reviewers check it; only their agreement opens the gate. One operator cannot run many fakes across the tundra of languages, since each identity needs real fluency in two tongues. Like an island reached only by a narrow causeway, standing grows where the bridge is walked, and each crossing is logged, showing who reached the zenith of two communities.
